quote: Brooklyn was a dream. All the things that happened there just couldn't happen. It was all dream stuff. Or was it all real and true and was it that she, Francie, was the dreamer?
author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

quote: The energy it took to exit mother’s womb is the same force required to manifest a dream...a different kind of struggle. Push, push, push!
author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quote: You would not be here TODAY if YESTERDAY was your defining moment. LIVE THIS DAY and move towards your dreams.
author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quote: You will not do incredible things without an incredible dream.
author: John Eliot

quote: A brick could make everything better for me. Now, if I could only find a way to get my hands on one. But it’s a silly dream, because I don’t have the ambition to get out from under my blanket and go out and grab the very thing I most desire.
author: Jarod Kintz,  A brick and a blanket walk into a bar

quote: Always have faith in yourself and the universe, for one will not get you anywhere without the other. Both must be equally strong to reach your desires, for they are the wings that will lift you to your dreams.
author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quote: Dreams link us to those who have already left this life.
author: Doug Dillon

quote: أصحاب العقول العظيمة لديهم أهداف وغايات، أما الآخرون فيكتفون بالأحلام.
author: واشطن إرفنج

quote: . . . and I don’t expect him to suborn his life into mine any more than I would change my dreams for him. We’re not one soul, one being, however much we love each other.
author: Ann Aguirre,  Aftermath

quote: While spirituality provides an efficient and endless fuel for your mind and body, you must burn that fuel with human action towards your goals, dreams, and desires.
author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quote: Encouragement is like water to the soul, it makes everything grow.
author: Chris Burkmenn

quote: Never stop believing that your dreams are eternal.
author: Truth Devour,  Unrequited

quote: i had a dream when i was 22 that someday i would go to the region of ice and snow and go on and on till i came to one of the poles of the earth
author: Ernest Shackleton

quote: If God didn't want you to be a dreamer, He wouldn't go around handing out dreams! That's a clue!
author: Mark Gorman

quote: You can capture this body of mine, take away my freedom and enslave me. You may even have the power to capture my soul and sentence me to the realm of eternal darkness. But my dreams you cannot touch. They are my will―the very essence of who I am. In them I laugh. In them I cry. In them I love. And in them.....I live.My dreams are untouchable and unceasing.
author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Eena, The Dawn and Rescue

quote: Making a dream into reality begins with what you have, not with what you are waiting on.
author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quote: Dream by making and make by dreaming.
author: Dejan Stojanovic

quote: If you have a dream, keep it. But write it down and take appropriate actions to see it manifest.
author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quote: Imagine in vibrant, wonderful detail your heart’s desire—a reality only you can envision, an adventure only you can direct.Then cradle your creation. Caress it. Mold it. Coddle it until it comes to life.And when your precious treasure grows so grand as to steal your breath away, set it free for all the world to experience. For that is how you live your dreams.
author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Eena, The Curse of Wanyaka Cave

quote: He who has the audacity to stop you from dreaming is he who had given you the imaginations to think, but not those who watch you as you explore the dreams!
author: Israelmore Ayivor

quote: I have always considered myself a person with a gypsy heart, and I Surrender my dreams to my soul, for it's a free sprit who believes in no boundaries of region and religion.
author: Megha Khare,  Write like no one is reading 2

quote: The reason most people give up so fast is that they look at how far they still have to go, instead of how far they have come.
author: Anonymous

quote: All have dreams, live for them, They add meaning to LIFE.The only thing that differentiates us from other beings is the fact that us can DREAM!!!
author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

quote: Dreaming is the poetry of Life, and we must be forgiven if we indulge in it a little.
author: John Galsworthy,  Five Speeches to P.E.N. Clubs and a Letter

quote: The only walls that exist are those you have placed in your mind. And whatever obstacles you conceive, exist only because you have forgotten what you have already achieved.
author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quote: The number of ways to live in one lifetime is limitless. So why limit yourself?
author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quote: Dreams. They start in your beautiful mind. Think of beautiful things and it will manifest into actions because your body will listen to you. Like it always does.
author: Diana Rose Morcilla

quote: One of the professors told me last week that he feels bad teaching with the way the economy is now. ‘What’s the point?’ he said. ‘Kids aren’t getting jobs.’ You never hear faculty talk that way. He did.
author: Daniel Amory,  Minor Snobs

quote: It's better to dare to dream big and achieve half of your dreams than to dream small dreams and achieve all
author: Bernard Kelvin Clive,  Your Dreams Will Not Die

quote: You never know who you're inspiring or uninspiring. People notice more than you think.
author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quote: All, all, becomes profitable. Education is of the most satisfying and available nature. I am at Smith! Which two years ago was a doubtful dream - and that fortuitous change of dream to reality has led me to desire more, and to lash myself onward - onward.
author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

quote: Discovering While Doing Is Natural...But,Doing Immediately After Discovering Is The Attitude of Winners!
author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

quote: Big things begin with big thinking.
author: Kent Healy

quote: I neither knew nor cared whether my experience was insanity, dreaming, or magic; but was determined to gaze on brilliance and gaiety at any cost.
author: H.P. Lovecraft

quote: At any given moment, your circumstances can change. You may not be where you want to be right now. You may not even be doing what you prefer to do. But, if you change your way of thinking and realize that you have all the opportunities available to you just like each one of us. You can begin to focus on what you want to achieve and make it happen
author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quote: Do we ever have to abandon all hope? Is it not perhaps a good thing that by refusing to give in to the evidence, the dreams that lie half awake in us all may persist?
author: Théodore Monod

quote: Each of us has an inner dream that we can unfold if we will just have the courage to admit what it is. And the faith to trust our own admission. The admitting is often very difficult.
author: Julia Cameron

quote: Dream big and never give up on those dreams. Who knows where they'll take you?
author: Amy McGuire

quote: God doesn't like it when we ask Him for the smallest things, dare to make your dream so big that He can conveniently fit into it and make your dream come true.
author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Best Option

quote: The excitement of dreams coming true is beyond the description of words.
author: Lailah Gifty Akita

quote: The disempowered mind believes dreams come true; the empowered mind knows you bring your dreams to life.
author: Steve Maraboli

quote: It is our action that determines the viability of our dream.
author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quote: If life throws you a few bad notes or vibrations, don't let them interrupt or alter your song.
author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quote: If I were a character in one of my books, I'd be the optimistic one, believing the best and urging others to do the same.
author: Stacy Hawkins Adams,  Dreams That Won't Let Go

quote: When every minute of your day is planned & you are packed for days, you shall soon realize that the pain of past fades, vision of life gets clearer and all that seemed to poison your life Ceases to exist.
author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

quote: Go higher and higher, until it becomes impossible to bring you down, I wanna use a microscope to locate you, don't even dream of coming down.
author: Michael Bassey Johnson

quote: I awoke one morning to find myself famous.
author: George Gordon Byron

quote: Le spectacle est le mauvais rêve de la société moderne enchaînée, qui n'exprime finalement que son désir de dormir. Le spectacle est le gardien de ce sommeil.
author: Guy Debord

quote: What is this slow blue dream of living, and this fevered death by dreaming?
author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

quote: Here, also, the future was cried aloud by the wind through the rocks, so that all those who heard would shiver, and then the liquid spring song of the thrush would make all the beauty of moonlight and sunlight blend together, making it true, so true, that happiness must come again
author: Elyne Mitchell,  Moon Filly

quote: Pursue your dreams. You will be amazed about what you can achieve.
author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Pearls of Wisdom: Great mind

quote: Keep the faith. The vision is always for the appointed time. Be patient, prayerful and wait for the fulfillment of your visions.
author: Lailah Gifty Akita

quote: We hold our dreams and ideals close to our hearts, where the promises are made to the future generations.
author: John Rachel,  A Long Night's Journey Into Daylight

quote: He had that sense, or inward prophecy,-- which a young man had better never have been born than not to have, and a mature man had better die at once than utterly to relinquish,-- that we are not doomed to creep on forever in the old bad way, but that, this very now, there are harbingers abroad of a golden era, to be accomplished in his own lifetime.
author: Nathaniel Hawthorne,  The House of the Seven Gables

quote: It take faith to follow your dreams and courage to reach them.
author: E'yen A. Gardner

quote: Faith is the poetry of our dreams; action is the builder of our reality.
author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quote: Let All Your Life’s Experiences Lead To More Writing & Encourage More Reading..!
author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

quote: Wishes are possibilities. Dare to make a wish.
author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Think Great: Be Great!

quote: Do not look down with disdain on what Christ spent so much to achieve for you.
author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

quote: Back when I was a competitive swimmer, I used to dream of going to the Olympics. But then I changed my mind, once I found out how expensive the tickets are.
author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quote: I want to find someone who's really into something like I'm really into something, so that I can support them and we can both cheer each other on. I've got a lot of dreams I want to achieve, and I hope someone can cheer me on as I'll cheer them on in their dreams.
author: Hunter Hayes

quote: Do you want to achieve something or do you just want to make money?” asked a nearby man in a white shirt to another man in a striped shirt. I waited for the answer as I slowly walked past them. “Why is it an either or question?” the man in the striped shirt finally murmured philosophically under a sip of beer. They both stood there looking at each other in thought.
author: Daniel Amory,  Minor Snobs

quote: Don’t you think most of those kids think too much about who got an A or a B when they were in law school and what that means to an inflated G.P.A. and not enough about the world?” asked Connor irrelevantly.
author: Daniel Amory,  Minor Snobs

quote: Your comfort zone is a place where you keep yourself in a self-illusion and nothing can grow there but your potentiality can grow only when you can think and grow out of that zone.
author: Rashedur Ryan Rahman

quote: I consider a dream like I consider a shadow,” answered Caeiro, with his usual divine, unexpected promptitude. “A shadow is real, but it’s less real than a rock. A dream is real — if it weren’t, it wouldn’t be a dream — but less real than a thing. That’s what being real is like.
author: Álvaro de Campos

quote: When our dreams don’t come true, sometimes we can hand them down to our children and hope that they will come true for them. The joy can be immeasurable just the same.
author: Isabel Lopez,  Isabel's Hand-Me-Down Dreams

quote: I made a sorry face in response to such strong insistence, but I couldn’t believe him. Fantasies were exactly that..…..fantasies. Whimsy. Wishes. Mere castles in the sky without foundation or substance. Dreams didn’t come true. To believe so would be to believe falsely, to surrender to madness, to give in to an unreliable hope that would crush me once again as it always, always did!
author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Dandelions: The Disappearance of Annabelle Fancher

quote: Gerisik angan dan deru lembut laju harapan.Waktu itu adalah menit-menit akhir menjelang malam di Bukit Angin. Daun-daun berwarna-warni dalam berbagai wujud melayang ke langit dan berkumpul mengelilingi puncak pusaran angin. Di sana, di balik awan, beradalah studio Sang Pelukis.
author: Fredrik Nael,  Fantasy Fiesta 2010: Antologi Cerita Fantasi Terbaik 2010

quote: Dreams are what keep us growing. They are what keep us alive. To give up, is to let our dreams die.
author: Phil Mitchell,  A Bright New Morning: An American Story

quote: The possibility of the dream gives strength.
author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Pearls of Wisdom: Great mind

quote: If there's a will, there's a way!I feel larger than LIFE--and look up to the stars who shine down on me and have become my own personal cheerleaders....as my fingers tap on my computer late into the night..
author: Donna Scrima-Black

quote: The fundamental virtue of success is that it allows you to know the true significance of what it means to have the freedom to make your dreams come true.
author: Stacy Keach

quote: Not every hen lay eggs. Not every hen that lays eggs gets them hatched. Not everyone born with greatness becomes as such. Go, hatch your eggs.
author: Israelmore Ayivor,  The Great Hand Book of Quotes

quote: I am unique...I play by a different set of rules; I am not intimidated by anything.
author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

quote: Couples should be able to share their dreams with one another. That’s why for just $69.69, you’ll like what I have to sell you. It’s not just one tube and two suction cups you each attach to your foreheads—it’s the Dream Tunnel.
author: Jarod Kintz,  Whenever You're Gone, I'm Here For You

quote: There's no heaven as I had known before. It's just a great universe which is available to be enjoyed by souls who dream about it.
author: Toba Beta,  Betelgeuse Incident: Insiden Bait Al-Jauza

quote: Should I have a doughnut or my disgusting cardboard?” asked Gwynn, as she drew up languidly before me at a study table in a bookstore on State Street, raising a puffed rice cake in the air. My eyes narrowed attentively at her face, but as I hesitated, she announced eagerly, “Disgusting cardboard it is!
author: Daniel Amory,  Minor Snobs

quote: Nobody really cares if you’re miserable, so you might as well be happy, and make the most of where you are
author: Germany Kent

quote: Whatever you dream of, there will be fulfillment.
author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Pearls of Wisdom: Great mind

quote: Anything is Possible!
author: Sealove

quote: We live in a time that hungers for HOPE; to believe in MIRACLES and DREAMS, for without these soul gems, humanity is ripped at the seams.
author: Debi Tibbles,  All Aboard! How Ollie Tibbles Became a Train

quote: Really, nobody was there?” I asked.“Well, nobody important,” he said, putting his glasses back on and blinking.
author: Daniel Amory,  Minor Snobs

quote: Wir werden alt und grau. Wir werden eines Tages verschlissen sein und aus der Welt verschwinden. Mit unseren Träumen ist das anders. Sie können in anderen Menschen weiterleben, wenn es uns schon längst, längst nicht mehr gibt.
author: Jostein Gaarder,  The Solitaire Mystery

quote: You can actually create the life you want. It all depends on how daring you desire it.
author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Pearls of Wisdom: Great mind

quote: Transform into your dream.
author: A.D. Posey

quote: A guidance counselor who has made a fetish of security, or who has unwittingly surrendered his thinking to economic determinism, may steer a youth away from his dream of becoming a poet, an artist, a musician or any other of thousands of things, because it offers no security, it does not pay well, there are no vacancies, it has no "future".
author: Henry M. Wriston

quote: Result of HARDWORK Is Neither Friends Nor Enemy,To the AGE Of the ACHIEVER!
author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

quote: I go to sleep in my business suit, because it makes my dreams of success seem more real.
author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quote: You become what you focus on and dream about.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: Dream the life you desire. Then live it with passion and love.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: You can never go further than your own thoughts.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: To dream your wildest dream, find your deepest desire.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: When you believe and act on your dreams, your dreams will become a reality.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: First I dream my life. Then I live in that dream with love and joy.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: Open your wings, fly toward the sky To live in your dream, even if it is high
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: If I dream under a moonlit night, should it vanish with the brightness of the morning sun?
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: I dream like a dew drop in the nightThen glitter in the morning sunlightThen it evaporates to embrace the sky
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: Even at 80, I shall say that I am yet to start, Yes! I shall say that I am yet to start, for that shall give me the real reason never ever to look back and see what I have done but, to look ahead and see the marvelous things I shall be able to do and the distinctive footprints I shall be able live and leave with the very seconds that shall be ahead of me! Life must never be over until all is over!
author: Ernest Agyemang Yeboah

quote: Think about peace, dream about peace, and take action to make the world peaceful.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: Be willing for purpose; it pays huge returns on investment. And along the journey, those who dis your willing sacrifice(s) will ponder their own foolishness.
author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quote: Simply just BE GRATEFUL what you have today, there is millions who'are crying for the place where you are today
author: Rashedur Rahman

quote: Let your thoughts, intentions, imaginations, and dreams fly under a clear blue sky with a spring breeze floating like a butterfly from flower to flower. See the beauty of mankind. Enjoy the nectar of life. It will shift your awareness to a higher consciousness.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: To be a success, dream with open eyes, have faith in your defined purpose, and act with deep love.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: Create your own path.Don't blindly follow the massess... because most of the time the "M"is silent.
author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely

quote: To find a focus, learn to love and dream.
author: Debasish Mridha

quote: عقلي له أحكام وقلبها له أحلام
author: أنيس منصور,  قالوا

quote: Pursue your dreams with all diligence.
author: Lailah Gifty Akita

quote: Your friends can be double-edged knife thy can either nurture you or destroy you. Choose them Wisely......
author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely

quote: Inspiration comes from so many sources. Music, other fiction, the non-fiction I read, TV shows, films, news reports, people I know, stories I hear, misheard words or lyrics, dreams... Motivation? The memory of the rush I get from a really good writing session - even on a bad day, I know I'll find that again if I keep going.
author: Trudi Canavan

quote: In art and dream may you proceed with abandon. In life may you proceed with balance and stealth.
author: Patti Smith
